say:2:1410460001:1.text: Your Highness! The riot in the commoners' district has been quelled.
say:2:1410460001:1.source_cn: 沙利叶殿下！平民区的暴乱已经平息。

say:3:1410460002:1.text: We've apprehended the ringleaders. How would you like to proceed with their punishment?
say:3:1410460002:1.source_cn: 我们逮捕了几名带头闹事者。请您指示后续该如何处置。

say:4:1410460003:0.text: Again... the same fixed script that plays out every few decades. I'm tired of it.
say:4:1410460003:0.source_cn: 又是这样……每隔几十年都会上演一次的固定戏码，我都看腻了。

say:5:1410460004:0.text: Xera, why don't you run along and report to Velara? The priests will handle this matter. Best not to meddle where we aren't needed.
say:5:1410460004:0.source_cn: 席蕾，你去向奎茵汇报吧。这件事归祭司们处理。我们……不...

say:6:1410460005:1.text:
But—
...Understood. As you command, for the glory of the Queen.
say:6:1410460005:1.source_cn: 这——\n是……遵命！为了女王的荣耀。

say:8:1410460006:0.text: Now then, Merlin! How was your first day on duty?
say:8:1410460006:0.source_cn: 梅林，第一次执勤感受如何？
say:8:1410460006:0.male: Now then, Merlin! How was your first day on duty?
say:8:1410460006:0.female: Now then, Merlin! How was your first day on duty?

choice_prompt:9:1410460006.text: Now then, Merlin! How was your first day on duty?
choice_prompt:9:1410460006.source_cn: 梅林，第一次执勤感受如何？
choice_prompt:9:1410460006.male: Now then, Merlin! How was your first day on duty?
choice_prompt:9:1410460006.female: Now then, Merlin! How was your first day on duty?

say:10:1410460007:0.text: Xera's a clever one, always finding ways to navigate rules without breaking them. A rare skill.
say:10:1410460007:0.source_cn: 席蕾是个聪明的女孩，知道如何在规则中找到余地。
say:10:1410460007:0.male: Xera's a clever one, always finding ways to navigate rules without breaking them. A rare skill.
say:10:1410460007:0.female: Xera's a clever one, always finding ways to navigate rules without breaking them. A rare skill.

choice:9:0:1.text: I met a guy called Valvaris...
choice:9:0:1.male: I met a guy called Valvaris...
choice:9:0:1.female: I met a guy called Valvaris...

say:11:1410460008:0.text: Ah, kindness... More often than not, it stems from a sense of superiority.
say:11:1410460008:0.source_cn: 她的善意是种……优越感的体现。
say:11:1410460008:0.male: Ah, kindness... More often than not, it stems from a sense of superiority.
say:11:1410460008:0.female: Ah, kindness... More often than not, it stems from a sense of superiority.

say:12:1410460009:0.text: Pity, after all, can wound deeper than cruelty.
say:12:1410460009:0.source_cn: 我只能说，怜悯有时候比残忍更伤人。
say:12:1410460009:0.male: Pity, after all, can wound deeper than cruelty.
say:12:1410460009:0.female: Pity, after all, can wound deeper than cruelty.

say:13:1410460010:0.text: Let me guess... You're starting to question the order of things.
say:13:1410460010:0.source_cn: 让我猜猜，你开始怀疑我们的秩序了？
say:13:1410460010:0.male: Let me guess... You're starting to question the order of things.
say:13:1410460010:0.female: Let me guess... You're starting to question the order of things.

say:14:1410460011:0.text: Sal'thorin's order is not about right or wrong, Merlin. It's about survival. My mother believes that living is more valuable than fairness.
say:14:1410460011:0.source_cn: 萨洛克兰的秩序不在于对错，而在于存续。至少在我母亲看来...
say:14:1410460011:0.male: Sal'thorin's order is not about right or wrong, Merlin. It's about survival. My mother believes that living is more valuable than fairness.
say:14:1410460011:0.female: Sal'thorin's order is not about right or wrong, Merlin. It's about survival. My mother believes that living is more valuable than fairness.

say:15:1410460012:0.text: That belief is shaped by her past. I don't share it. But change... well, change requires the right moment.
say:15:1410460012:0.source_cn: 这跟她的经历有关，我并不认同。但改变——需要时机。
say:15:1410460012:0.male: That belief is shaped by her past. I don't share it. But change... well, change requires the right moment.
say:15:1410460012:0.female: That belief is shaped by her past. I don't share it. But change... well, change requires the right moment.

say:16:1410460013:0.text: If you have the time, take a stroll through the royal city. The most fascinating truths are often tucked away in the least obvious places.
say:16:1410460013:0.source_cn: 以后有空可以多在王城里转转。很多有趣的事情，往往藏在不...
say:16:1410460013:0.male: If you have the time, take a stroll through the royal city. The most fascinating truths are often tucked away in the least obvious places.
say:16:1410460013:0.female: If you have the time, take a stroll through the royal city. The most fascinating truths are often tucked away in the least obvious places.

say:17:1410460014:0.text: Ah, but that's for another time. Right now, there's work to be done.
say:17:1410460014:0.source_cn: 啊，不过那是以后的事了。现在还是工作时间……
say:17:1410460014:0.male: Ah, but that's for another time. Right now, there's work to be done.
say:17:1410460014:0.female: Ah, but that's for another time. Right now, there's work to be done.

say:18:1410460015:0.text: Go find Indris. He's at the <style="highlight">Lunaris Altar</style>. There are far more pressing matters awaiting you.
say:18:1410460015:0.male: Go find Indris. He's at the <style="highlight">Lunaris Altar</style>. There are far more pressing matters awaiting you.
say:18:1410460015:0.female: Go find Indris. He's at the <style="highlight">Lunaris Altar</style>. There are far more pressing matters awaiting you.

choice:9:3:4.text: ... Is this truly the best way?
choice:9:3:4.source_cn: ……这种秩序，真的是最好的选择吗
choice:9:3:4.male: ... Is this truly the best way?
choice:9:3:4.female: ... Is this truly the best way?
